description: Parking Meters, Signs & Runs DLR is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Location of parking meters, parking signs and parking runs within the the Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council administrative area. GeoJSON and csv datasets contain information on location, hours of operation, hourly tariff, and restrictions. Please note that changes and upgrades occurring since the infrastructure was surveyed in 2018 will not be represented here. Coverage: Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council. Its tags are DLR, DLRCC, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Transport and Infrastructure, car-parking. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
